name: Extra Form of the Mythical Beast
body:
You can assume mythical beast form more often than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Form of the Mythical Beast class feature, base attack bonus +5.

Benefit(s): You may use your Form of the Mythical Beast ability two additional times per day.
